sections.description:
0.20.33: ライセンス画面の円換算が最大サイト数基準だったため $29.00 の請求に対して $35 相当の円が併記されていた不整合を修正。円は請求対象サイト数（追加サイト数）基準になり、内訳の文言も「追加サイト数」に修正。
0.20.32: ライセンス画面の従量課金の説明を実際の課金方式（登録時に Stripe の利用量メーターへ報告）に合わせて修正。プラグインのヘッダ・バージョン定数・アセット版・readme の Stable tag を 0.20.32 に統一。
AutoRepair AI Hosting Beta. Pre-update protection, full-site backup and restore, isolated restore verification, proof reports, hub management, usage and billing display, and a built-in diagnostic panel. USD-based billing display.
sections.changelog:
0.20.36

0.20.36: 文書のみの更新（機能変更なし）。README-JA.md の 0.16.0 変更履歴に残っていた「Stripeはテストモード設定時のみ、Paddleは準備中です。」を、現在の実態に合わせて修正しました。Stripe は本番モードで稼働し（10サイトまで月額 $29.00、11サイト目以降は1サイトにつき月額 $3.00）、Paddle は引き続き準備中です。

= 0.20.35 = * Documentation only (no functional change). Corrected the start-here guide, which still said Stripe was only a test-mode draft and that live automatic billing was not enabled. Stripe now runs in live mode: up to 10 sites for $29.00 per month, and $3.00 per site per month from the 11th site, reported to the usage meter. = 0.20.34 = * Documentation only (no functional change). Updated the version stamp in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md to 0.20.34. * Recorded the 0.20.33 yen-conversion fix in this changelog. The licence screen converts yen from the billable site count, so a $29.00/month plan (up to 10 sites) shows about 4,577 yen at 157.83 yen/USD instead of about 5,523 yen. 0.20.33: ライセンス画面の円換算が最大サイト数基準だったため $29.00 の請求に対して $35 相当の円が併記されていた不整合を修正。円は請求対象サイト数（追加サイト数）基準になり、内訳の文言も「追加サイト数」に修正。 0.20.32: ライセンス画面の従量課金の説明を実際の課金方式（登録時に Stripe の利用量メーターへ報告）に合わせて修正。プラグインのヘッダ・バージョン定数・アセット版・readme の Stable tag を 0.20.32 に統一。

0.20.31

  • Distribution: the plugin zip now bundles LICENSE (GNU GPL v2.0 full text) and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, so a downloaded copy carries its own licence text.
  • Docs: added a licence section to README-JA.md. No functional change.

0.20.30

  • Docs: the start-here guide described a two-level package (an outer zip holding a plugin zip). The distribution is a single zip whose root is autorepair-ai-hosting-beta/, so the guide now matches the real upload flow.
  • Version: aligned the plugin header, version constant, asset version and readme Stable tag to 0.20.30.

0.20.29

  • Docs: the current guides no longer name an old release. The start-here guide, the vault guide and the restore-test results heading carried version numbers from older builds.
  • Docs: the distribution pointer now names the current package, and the Japanese readme opens with the current version instead of an old release heading.
  • Version: aligned the plugin header, version constant, asset version and readme Stable tag to 0.20.29.

0.20.28

  • Docs: the isolated restore-test guide now builds the runner image with the tag the code actually looks for (aaihb-restore-test:0.20.6). The guide said 0.14.2, so anyone following it ended at "test environment not ready".
  • Docs: removed the stale version numbers from the restore-test guide title and its first preparation step.
  • Package: removed stray __pycache__ bytecode from the distribution.
  • Version: aligned the plugin header, version constant, asset version and readme Stable tag to 0.20.28.

0.20.27

  • Fix the stale version labels in the app header and the recovery vault hero: both printed a hard-coded build number (0.20.13 / 0.20.20), so every release showed an old number. They now read the plugin version constant.
  • Align the package version strings (plugin header, version constant, asset version, readme Stable tag, distribution note) to 0.20.27.

0.20.26

  • English pass 2: every remaining screen internationalized - repair, recovery, vault admin/io/db/test/guard/full/command, business checks, reports, workspace, dashboard, notifications, onboarding, partner API, diagnostics, compatibility, backup jobs, billing, verification.

0.20.20

  • vault-admin.php (Backup and restore) translated to English.

0.20.19

  • value.php (Value and support) translated to English.
  • Connection settings are mirrored in encrypted form and restored automatically when they are wiped.
  • A 409 sequence_conflict is now realigned and retried automatically.

0.20.18

  • control-center.php translated to English.
